EN:
In case you're wondering what I'm
doing with this shovel, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}it's none of
your business!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}What if I told you I was looking for
treasure?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} You'd just try to find it
first,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} wouldn't you?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I've said too much already{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
ES:
Te estás preguntando qué hago con
esta pala, ¿verdad? {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Pues no es de
tu incumbencia!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Si te dijera que estoy buscando un
tesoro,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} seguro que serías {{TAG:000E:0006:040065006C0004006C006100}} primer{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}
en ir a buscarlo.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ah, ya he hablado demasiado{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Si tu me demandais ce que je fais
ici avec une pelle, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}je te répondrais
que cela ne te regarde pas !
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Excuse-moi si je suis abrupte avec
toi...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Mais je ne peux pas t'avouer que je
suis à la recherche d'un trésor, tu
essaierais de le trouver avant moi.
{{TAG:0003:0029:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Oh, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}non ! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}J'en ai encore trop dit{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
Se ti stai chiedendo cosa ci faccia
con una pala in mano.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Beh,
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}non te lo chiedere!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Mettiamo che stessi cercando
un tesoro:{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} poi lo cercheresti
anche tu,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} vero?
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ma quand'è che imparerò
a stare zitta.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
DE:
Falls du dich fragst, warum ich hier
mit einer Schaufel zugange bin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Das geht dich gar nichts an!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Wenn ich sage, dass ich einen Schatz
zu finden gedenke, würdest du nur
selbst anfangen zu graben.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh nein! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich rede schon wieder viel
zu viel!
